61:   def initialize(*arg)
62:     super
63:     @justswitched          = [false, false, false, false]
64:     @battleAI.battlePalace = true
65:   end
66: 
67:   def pbMoveCategory(move)
68:     if move.target == :User || move.function_code == "MultiTurnAttackBideThenReturnDoubleDamage"
69:       return 1
70:     elsif move.statusMove? ||
71:           move.function_code == "CounterPhysicalDamage" || move.function_code == "CounterSpecialDamage"
72:       return 2
73:     else
74:       return 0
75:     end
76:   end
77: 
78:   # Different implementation of pbCanChooseMove, ignores Imprison/Torment/Taunt/Disable/Encore
79:   def pbCanChooseMovePartial?(idxPokemon, idxMove)
80:     thispkmn = @battlers[idxPokemon]
81:     thismove = thispkmn.moves[idxMove]
82:     return false if !thismove
83:     return false if thismove.pp <= 0
84:     if thispkmn.effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand] &&
85:        thismove.id != thispkmn.effects[PBEffects::ChoiceBand] &&
86:        thispkmn.hasActiveItem?(:CHOICEBAND)
87:       return false
88:     end
89:     # though incorrect, just for convenience (actually checks Torment later)
90:     if thispkmn.effects[PBEffects::Torment] &&
91:        thispkmn.lastMoveUsed && thismove.id == thispkmn.lastMoveUsed
92:       return false
93:     end
94:     return true
95:   end
96: 
97:   def pbRegisterMove(idxBattler, idxMove, _showMessages = true)
98:     this_battler = @battlers[idxBattler]
99:     @choices[idxBattler][0] = :UseMove
100:     @choices[idxBattler][1] = idxMove   # Index of move to be used (-2="Incapable of using its power...")
101:     @choices[idxBattler][2] = (idxMove == -2) ? @struggle : this_battler.moves[idxMove]   # Battle::Move object
102:     @choices[idxBattler][3] = -1   # No target chosen yet
103:   end
104: 
105:   def pbAutoFightMenu(idxBattler)
106:     this_battler = @battlers[idxBattler]
107:     nature = this_battler.nature.id
108:     randnum = @battleAI.pbAIRandom(100)
109:     category = 0
110:     atkpercent = 0
111:     defpercent = 0
112:     if this_battler.effects[PBEffects::Pinch]
113:       atkpercent = @@BattlePalacePinchTable[nature][0]
114:       defpercent = atkpercent + @@BattlePalacePinchTable[nature][1]
115:     else
116:       atkpercent = @@BattlePalaceUsualTable[nature][0]
117:       defpercent = atkpercent + @@BattlePalaceUsualTable[nature][1]
118:     end
119:     if randnum < atkpercent
120:       category = 0
121:     elsif randnum < atkpercent + defpercent
122:       category = 1
123:     else
124:       category = 2
125:     end
126:     moves = []
127:     this_battler.moves.length.times do |i|
128:       next if !pbCanChooseMovePartial?(idxBattler, i)
129:       next if pbMoveCategory(this_battler.moves[i]) != category
130:       moves[moves.length] = i
131:     end
132:     if moves.length == 0
133:       # No moves of selected category
134:       pbRegisterMove(idxBattler, -2)
135:     else
136:       chosenmove = moves[@battleAI.pbAIRandom(moves.length)]
137:       pbRegisterMove(idxBattler, chosenmove)
138:     end
139:     return true
140:   end
141: 
142:   def pbPinchChange(battler)
143:     return if !battler || battler.fainted?
144:     return if battler.effects[PBEffects::Pinch] || battler.status == :SLEEP
145:     return if battler.hp > battler.totalhp / 2
146:     nature = battler.nature.id
147:     battler.effects[PBEffects::Pinch] = true
148:     case nature
149:     when :QUIET, :BASHFUL, :NAIVE, :QUIRKY, :HARDY, :DOCILE, :SERIOUS
150:       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is eager for more!", battler.pbThis))
151:     when :CAREFUL, :RASH, :LAX, :SASSY, :MILD, :TIMID
152:       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} began growling deeply!", battler.pbThis))
153:     when :GENTLE, :ADAMANT, :HASTY, :LONELY, :RELAXED, :NAUGHTY
154:       pbDisplay(_INTL("A glint appears in {1}'s eyes!", battler.pbThis(true)))
155:     when :JOLLY, :BOLD, :BRAVE, :CALM, :IMPISH, :MODEST
156:       pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} is getting into position!", battler.pbThis))
157:     end
158:   end
159: 
160:   def pbEndOfRoundPhase
161:     super
162:     return if @decision != 0
163:     allBattlers.each { |b| pbPinchChange(b) }
164:   end
165: end

170: class Battle::AI
171:   attr_accessor :battlePalace
172: 
173:   alias _battlePalace_initialize initialize unless private_method_defined?(:_battlePalace_initialize)
174: 
175:   def initialize(*arg)
176:     _battlePalace_initialize(*arg)
177:     @justswitched = [false, false, false, false]
178:   end
179: 
180:   unless method_defined?(:_battlePalace_pbChooseToSwitchOut)
181:     alias _battlePalace_pbChooseToSwitchOut pbChooseToSwitchOut
182:   end
183: 
184:   def pbChooseToSwitchOut(force_switch = false)
185:     return _battlePalace_pbChooseToSwitchOut(force_switch) if !@battlePalace
186:     thispkmn = @user
187:     idxBattler = @user.index
188:     shouldswitch = false
189:     if thispkmn.effects[PBEffects::PerishSong] == 1
190:       shouldswitch = true
191:     elsif !@battle.pbCanChooseAnyMove?(idxBattler) &&
192:           thispkmn.turnCount && thispkmn.turnCount > 5
193:       shouldswitch = true
194:     else
195:       hppercent = thispkmn.hp * 100 / thispkmn.totalhp
196:       percents = []
197:       maxindex = -1
198:       maxpercent = 0
199:       factor = 0
200:       @battle.pbParty(idxBattler).each_with_index do |pkmn, i|
201:         if @battle.pbCanSwitch?(idxBattler, i)
202:           percents[i] = 100 * pkmn.hp / pkmn.totalhp
203:           if percents[i] > maxpercent
204:             maxindex = i
205:             maxpercent = percents[i]
206:           end
207:         else
208:           percents[i] = 0
209:         end
210:       end
211:       if hppercent < 50
212:         factor = (maxpercent < hppercent) ? 20 : 40
213:       end
214:       if hppercent < 25
215:         factor = (maxpercent < hppercent) ? 30 : 50
216:       end
217:       case thispkmn.status
218:       when :SLEEP, :FROZEN
219:         factor += 20
220:       when :POISON, :BURN
221:         factor += 10
222:       when :PARALYSIS
223:         factor += 15
224:       end
225:       if @justswitched[idxBattler]
226:         factor -= 60
227:         factor = 0 if factor < 0
228:       end
229:       shouldswitch = (pbAIRandom(100) < factor)
230:       if shouldswitch && maxindex >= 0
231:         @battle.pbRegisterSwitch(idxBattler, maxindex)
232:         return true
233:       end
234:     end
235:     @justswitched[idxBattler] = shouldswitch
236:     if shouldswitch
237:       @battle.pbParty(idxBattler).each_with_index do |_pkmn, i|
238:         next if !@battle.pbCanSwitch?(idxBattler, i)
239:         @battle.pbRegisterSwitch(idxBattler, i)
240:         return true
241:       end
242:     end
243:     return false
244:   end
245: end
